description.name: Entry
description.text: Seven single attacks (0.90 each) capped at 19999, grants [Twin Element Mode II (Lightning, Dark)], [Damage Cap +10000], [Dual Awoken High Commander Mode I (Ravus)], [(Lightning/Dark) Resonance +3% Boost] and [Weakness Resonance +3% Boost] to the user, grants [Violet Arc 1]/[Violet Arc 2] to the user if 0-2/3+ party members have any Attach Lightning or Attach Dark, grants [Weakness Resonance +3% Boost] to Lunafreya

description.name: Twin Element Mode II (Lightning, Dark)
description.text: Grants [Attach Lightning with Stacking]/[Attach Dark with Stacking] after using a Lightning/Dark ability

description.name: Dual Awoken High Commander Mode I (Ravus)
description.text: Lightning and Dark abilities deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Lightning and Dark abilities trigger 2 additional times

description.name: (Lightning/Dark) Resonance +3% Boost
description.text: Lightning and Dark abilities deal 3% more damage

description.name: Weakness Resonance +3% Boost
description.text: Increases damage dealt by 3% when exploiting elemental weaknesses

description.name: Violet Arc 1
description.text: Cast speed x1.50/2.00/2.50/3.00 and 5/10/15/20% additional critical damage for Lightning and Dark abilities after using 1/2/3/4+ Lightning or Dark abilities, removed if the character hasn't [Dual Awoken High Commander Mode I (Ravus)]

description.name: Violet Arc 2
description.text: Cast speed x3.00 and 20% additional critical damage for Lightning and Dark abilities, removed if the character hasn't [Dual Awoken High Commander Mode I (Ravus)]

description.name: Dual Shift
description.text: Grants [Instant ATB 1] and [Dual Awoken High Commander Mode II (Ravus)], removes [Dual Awoken High Commander Mode I (Ravus)]
